name: Coast Funds Stewardship Project Funding
summary: Standing funding for participating First Nations, and the stewardship offices and societies acting for them, to run conservation projects such as monitoring, habitat and coastal restoration and protected-area management in the Great Bear Coast region.

geography.label: Great Bear Rainforest, Great Bear Sea and Haida Gwaii

status.quote: Participating First Nations can apply to access funding through Coast Funds at any time during the year.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include: The governing bodies of participating First Nations specified in related agreements that are listed as a qualified donee with the Canada Revenue Agency Stewardship offices, resource management departments, or non-profit societies with delegated responsibility for conservation on behalf of a participating First Nation.

geography.quote: focused on sustaining or enhancing the ecological integrity of the Great Bear Rainforest, Great Bear Sea, and Haida Gwaii (the Project Area, also known as the Great Bear Coast)

access.quote: Participating First Nations can apply to access funding through Coast Funds at any time during the year.
